evaluator: Independent evaluator r1; executed by Blender Python after reopening the saved asset in Blender 4.5.15 LTS.

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: OSM way 910910470 is directly tagged The Moosehead Lounge, 434 North Grant Street; the captured West Lafayette BPW map labels Moosehead at the site. The named, addressed OSM ring is compared against an imagery overlay and the mesh structural outline (maximum source-to-mesh vertex residual 0.0000 m). Purdue's name query found no Moosehead; FID 855 is an Old Purdue Exponent candidate and is explicitly excluded.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: The object retains campus-world coordinates and identity object transform. OSM/project local-conversion footprint bbox is [[294.6150767505242, 322.02586401651496], [145.68447999984983, 158.78719999990608]]; reopened asset world bbox is [[294.550048828125, 322.02587890625], [145.62908935546875, 158.78720092773438]]; maximum bbox difference is 0.065 m. Orthophoto overlay supports site alignment. Approximate geographic conversion and community-mapped source are documented.
findings: The local projection is approximate rather than surveyed, and no independent parcel survey or Purdue-named GIS feature was found.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: OSM building:levels=2 supports a two-level interpretation. Reopened mesh reaches 7.60 m, with 5.25 m eaves; both heights are labeled estimated. Indiana current imagery supports roof plan context only.
findings: No source establishes measured eave or ridge height.
One broad gable is schematic; the orthophoto shows roof complexity/sections that are not established by the model, and the gable end walls are not filled to the roof ridge.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: The OSM snapshot includes 3 main entrance nodes on level 0; the asset models doors at these locations (nearest door-face vertex distances [0.5296406491289143, 0.5296377406856001, 0.5296404742216817]). Rendered views show two rows of repeated rectangular windows and generic masonry/trim/glazing.
findings: No direct facade photographs or elevations were located; window count, sizes, materials, facade rhythm, and exact entry construction are schematic.
The massing lacks gable-end infill and visible source-backed architectural details.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Independently reopened in Blender 4.5.15 LTS; exact scene/collection/object identities persist; asset collection has one mesh object, 426 vertices, 314 faces, no modifiers, and no file-backed image dependencies. Scene has 6 objects including a separate render-only collection. Source snapshots, reconciliation, validation, and four renders are present.

materials: Muted warm masonry — generic material, facade unverified
evidence.purdue_fid_855_conflict: README assignment crosswalk identifies FID 855 as Old Purdue Exponent Building; it is not a Moosehead match.

findings: The local projection is approximate rather than surveyed, and no independent parcel survey or Purdue-named GIS feature was found.
No source establishes measured eave or ridge height.
One broad gable is schematic; the orthophoto shows roof complexity/sections that are not established by the model, and the gable end walls are not filled to the roof ridge.
No direct facade photographs or elevations were located; window count, sizes, materials, facade rhythm, and exact entry construction are schematic.
The massing lacks gable-end infill and visible source-backed architectural details.
uncertainties: OSM tags building:levels=2, but no scaled elevation or measured height source was found.
Eave 5.25 m and ridge 7.60 m are explicit estimates; the single gable form is schematic and roof divisions are unverified.
Facade windows/materials are generic schematic placeholders; available evidence has no street-level facade photograph or elevation.
The 2018 Indiana footprint is a conflicting merged/adjacent-roof candidate and is disclosed, not used as the shell.
Purdue GIS FID 855 is correctly excluded: the assignment queue and README map it to the Old Purdue Exponent Building.
